programme.title: 30 Minute Meals S28E15 -Tacos, Tacos, Tacos
programme.desc: Rachael Ray is fired up for a smokin' taco night with Mezcal Shrimp Tacos with Gauc Crema.

programme.title: 第15集 - 就愛塔可
programme.desc: 在本集節目裡, 熱愛週二塔可日的瑞秋要做梅斯卡爾酒鮮蝦塔可餅, 她先著手準備塔可餅的醬料, 烹煮洋蔥、醋醃煙燻辣椒、小茴香籽、火烤番茄及梅斯卡爾酒, 最後再放入大蝦, 煮出非常辛辣的鮮蝦醬料。此外她也以墨西哥酸奶油、塞拉諾辣椒、洋蔥、萊姆汁及酪梨來做可降低辣味的醬汁, 味道就像綿密清涼的酪梨沙拉醬, 她也切了捲心萵苣絲和蘿蔔薄片來當配菜, 最後把玉米薄餅直接放在爐火上烤得非常酥香, 各項食材一字排開就是賓客可以自己動手組合的塔可餅吧, 讓她的塔可餅之夜好吃又好玩。

programme.title: 30 Minute Meals S28E16 -Chicken Curry Chili
programme.desc: Rachael Ray's Curry Chicken Chili with Sriracha gets a spicy kick from jalapeno and sriracha.

programme.title: 第16集 - 是拉差辣椒醬雞肉咖哩
programme.desc: 瑞秋最愛的兩樣東西就是辣椒跟咖哩, 所以在本集節目裡, 她要做是拉差辣椒醬雞肉咖哩, 她準備了450克的雞胸絞肉, 下鍋開始煎香攪散, 還逐漸加入不同的香料, 包括伽蘭瑪香料, 小茴香和芫荽, 也放了墨西哥辣椒與雞高湯, 烹煮成可口的辣肉醬, 還加上優格與芒果甜酸醬, 增添一絲甜味, 最後撒上碎細香蔥及胡荽葉。雖然她不愛無國界料理, 卻認為這道辣肉醬與咖哩真的很搭。她另外也開始烘烤印度薄餅, 並為優格做的印度薄餅刷上融化奶油, 搭配這道美味的辣肉醬。瑞秋也想起自己有次參加網路挑戰, 一口氣吃掉十種辣椒醬, 最後回到家付出慘痛代價的回憶。

programme.title: 24 In 24: Last Chef Standing S1E8 -Shift 8: Elevation
programme.desc: In the final hours, Michael Symon and Esther Choi revisit an old challenge where the chefs must cook the best dishes of their lives.

programme.title: 第8集 - 第八輪:晉升
programme.desc: 這場歷時24小時的史詩級烹飪賽終於進入尾聲。第八輪的主題是晉升, 倖存的四位主廚必須搶下理想的肉品, 並以不同的肉品部位製做餐前小點、開胃菜和主菜。

programme.title: Man V. Food S4E27 -Detroit Michigan
programme.desc: Casey Webb's appetizing adventure brings him to Detroit for the famous Detroit-style, Sicilian square pan pizza.

programme.title: 第27集 - 密西根州底特律
programme.desc: 本集節目中, 主持人要前往位在密西根底特律的'牙買加風味菜'餐館, 挑戰六隻淋上混合了蘇格蘭帽椒和鬼椒辣醬的超辣雞翅, 主持人是否有辦法挑戰成功, 登上名人牆呢?

programme.title: Man V. Food S4E28 -Cleveland Ohio
programme.desc: Casey Webb's food frenzy brings him to Cleveland for a corned beef colossus, a caramel ice cream sundae at a sweet time machine .

programme.title: 第28集 - 克里夫蘭俄亥俄州
programme.desc: 這次凱西前往俄亥俄州克里夫蘭品嚐美食, 先到史萊曼餐廳享用花了長時間製作的巨無霸的裸麥麵包醃牛肉三明治, 接著前往甜蜜摩西汽水店, 穿越時空品嚐鹽味法式焦糖冰淇淋加上熱巧克力與自製焦糖爆米花等配料的鮑伯費勒球場聖代, 最後一站則是到希臘村燒烤餐廳面對3.6公斤的希臘捲餅挑戰。

programme.title: 第5集 - 雞蛋檔案
programme.desc: 本集美味秘訣升級版, 主持人回顧過去於1999年介紹雞蛋的集數。向觀眾解釋雞蛋的分級、內部構造, 以及三種蛋料理的改良烹調方式－煎蛋、炒蛋, 以及水煮蛋。主持人也指出, 90年代時人們普遍認為, 食用生雞蛋會導致沙門氏菌感染, 但現在的雞蛋經過消毒, 不再需要擔心。

programme.title: 第2集 - 年度大賽
programme.desc: The contenders take on the fastest and wildest BBQ games as they race for the coveted 'PIG-asus' trophy and some major advantages.

programme.title: 30 Minute Meals S28E15 -Tacos, Tacos, Tacos
programme.desc: Rachael Ray is fired up for a smokin' taco night with Mezcal Shrimp Tacos with Gauc Crema.

programme.title: 第15集 - 就愛塔可
programme.desc: 在本集節目裡, 熱愛週二塔可日的瑞秋要做梅斯卡爾酒鮮蝦塔可餅, 她先著手準備塔可餅的醬料, 烹煮洋蔥、醋醃煙燻辣椒、小茴香籽、火烤番茄及梅斯卡爾酒, 最後再放入大蝦, 煮出非常辛辣的鮮蝦醬料。此外她也以墨西哥酸奶油、塞拉諾辣椒、洋蔥、萊姆汁及酪梨來做可降低辣味的醬汁, 味道就像綿密清涼的酪梨沙拉醬, 她也切了捲心萵苣絲和蘿蔔薄片來當配菜, 最後把玉米薄餅直接放在爐火上烤得非常酥香, 各項食材一字排開就是賓客可以自己動手組合的塔可餅吧, 讓她的塔可餅之夜好吃又好玩。

programme.title: 30 Minute Meals S28E16 -Chicken Curry Chili
programme.desc: Rachael Ray's Curry Chicken Chili with Sriracha gets a spicy kick from jalapeno and sriracha.

programme.title: 第16集 - 是拉差辣椒醬雞肉咖哩
programme.desc: 瑞秋最愛的兩樣東西就是辣椒跟咖哩, 所以在本集節目裡, 她要做是拉差辣椒醬雞肉咖哩, 她準備了450克的雞胸絞肉, 下鍋開始煎香攪散, 還逐漸加入不同的香料, 包括伽蘭瑪香料, 小茴香和芫荽, 也放了墨西哥辣椒與雞高湯, 烹煮成可口的辣肉醬, 還加上優格與芒果甜酸醬, 增添一絲甜味, 最後撒上碎細香蔥及胡荽葉。雖然她不愛無國界料理, 卻認為這道辣肉醬與咖哩真的很搭。她另外也開始烘烤印度薄餅, 並為優格做的印度薄餅刷上融化奶油, 搭配這道美味的辣肉醬。瑞秋也想起自己有次參加網路挑戰, 一口氣吃掉十種辣椒醬, 最後回到家付出慘痛代價的回憶。

programme.desc: 當茱莉亞開始懷疑她身為牙科外科醫師的丈夫正在外遇時, 她選擇先設法取得證據, 才準備啟動離婚程序, 以免冒著失去兩人共同建立的慈善事業控制權的風險。

programme.title: 第31集
programme.desc: 《澳洲頂級廚師》中的澳洲經典週以一個令人興奮的日子畫下句點, 當來賓評審和澳洲偶像羅伯特•厄爾文 (Robert Irwin) 設置了一個澳洲本土食材的淘汰挑戰。

programme.title: 第1集 - 企鵝求婚記
programme.desc: 一起見證南極洲的巴布亞企鵝用一塊石頭表示愛意，走訪馬達加斯加看看狐猴如何利用有毒的千足蟲來擊退害蟲。齊來跟紅鸛學習化妝技巧，並看看蜜蜂獾展示開鎖技巧。

programme.title: 第2集 - 寄居蟹．找個家
programme.desc: 一起來到在伯利茲的「海灘銀行」，見證寄居蟹有序排隊，以我們最歷史悠久的貨幣——貝殼進行交易。然後走訪塞內加爾，探望黑猩猩和他的寵物麝貓。見證一隻水獺如何以「人質」換來免費午餐，並到雨林中與切葉蟻們的一起收割。

programme.title: 第1集 - 拯救者們
programme.desc: 狗隻在本集正以各種令人驚訝的方式來幫助我們。一隻大丹犬向我們展示如何改變一名13歲的馬薩諸塞州女孩的生活，她只剩有限的生命。一隻隸屬搜索和救援隊的邊境牧羊犬曾經在動物收容所等死，但現在是加州特遣部隊不可或缺的一員，當地震、颶風或致命的泥石流襲擊時負責尋找倖存者。尚比亞的反偷獵犬路格正在檢查走私非法象牙和野生動物。最後，一隻紐芬蘭犬幫助教導牠的德國牧羊犬學徒，她需要成為意大利加爾達湖的水上救援犬。

programme.title: 第1集 - 小海獺求包養
programme.desc: 馬堤侯連拿博士和海洋哺乳類救援隊趕著拯救被塑料套索困住的一大群海獅；一頭小水獺孤兒被一個新家庭收養。另外，在溫哥華水族館裡，一隻企鵝因一種神秘疾病而病倒。

programme.title: 第5集 - 克莉絲朵、艾莎與索爾
programme.desc: 一起去看看樹懶艾莎的近況。佩德羅把自己的人生奉獻給照顧牠，因為牠在一次墜落意外後癱瘓了。了解為什麼狼索爾願意讓牠的人類夥伴史提夫加入自己的族群，接著再看看克莉絲汀和博如何讓浣熊水晶的生活變得更加方便自在。

programme.title: 第6集 - 奧茲、瑞瑞與蓋亞
programme.desc: 跟水獺奧茲以及他的教練萊絲莉一起學習游泳，接著看看佩特羅內爾如何贏得犀牛孤兒莉莉的信任，牠曾因偷獵者而受到創傷。和老鼠科比一起嗅出地雷，並和雙髻鯊蓋婭一起自由潛水。

programme.title: 第1集 - 三人行
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在繁殖季節中與米克和阿黛爾一起糾纏不清，他們救了一隻被饑餓的蟒蛇威脅的傑克羅素犬。與米克一起在泳池中對抗一條致命的紅腹黑蛇，並與斯圖和莉芙一起在建築工地上處理東部棕蛇。

programme.title: 第2集 - 雙重麻煩
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​準備好進行一場火熱的救援，當丹和傑絲從後院移除交配中的東部棕蛇時，然後屏住呼吸，因為米克在沙發墊裡嗅出了一條高度有毒的蛇。稍後，觀看斯圖拆解一個雞舍以撬出一條地毯蟒蛇。

programme.title: Go Buster S3E2 -Learning How to Be a Good Friend!
programme.desc: Join Buster as he learns how to be a good friend! When a new, shy student named Ash the firetruck joins the school, Buster sees he's all alone & invites him to play. Then, Buster learns another important lesson when he starts to lose a game of snakes & ladders & decides to cheat. From learning that sports aren't all about winning to standing up for his friends during a sleepover, Buster is on his way to being the best friend ever!

programme.title: 第2集 - 學習如何當好朋友！
programme.desc: 巴斯特是一輛可愛又直白的小巴士，擁有熱愛冒險的靈魂和好奇的心。他最喜歡的，其實還是探索高科技的家鄉「Wheelieville」，與他的汽車好友「The Bumper Bunch」一起經歷大大小小的冒險。

programme.title: Go Buster S2E1 -Teamwork Makes the Dream Work!
programme.desc: Buster is learning that teamwork makes the dream work! During a big soccer match, Buster is very competitive, but he learns the value of being a team player to help his team win the game. Then, when he & his friend Scout get lost in a big hedge maze, they find that they have to work together to find their way out. From cleaning up toys to helping a friend who is stuck in the mud, teamwork always saves the day!

The adventure continues with a trip to a fun theme park, where the family enjoys the merry-go-round, bumper cars & yummy cotton candy!

Plus, Blippi & FETCH help a nervous crane learn to build a skyscraper!

The Beast Stalker
programme.desc: A traffic accident changed their lives forever. In capturing wanted criminal Zhang Yidong, Sergeant Tang Fei was involved in a gunfight and car accident that put the criminal in a coma. But in the process he also crippled an fellow officer, and mistakenly shot dead the elder daughter of public prosecutor and single mother Gao Min. Unable to handle the guilt, Tang Fei succumbs to a fog of pain. Gao Min, meanwhile, pours all her love and attention to her younger daughter Ling. Three months later, the criminal Zhang Yidong awakens from his coma. Gao Min, who had been working hard on bringing him to justice, insists he stand trial immediately.

programme.title: 証人
programme.desc: 一宗車禍, 徹底改變了他們的一生。沙展唐飛在追捕通緝犯張日東時, 發生了嚴重車禍, 之後更開鎗誤殺了一名小女孩。沉痛的他終日活在陰霾裡；檢控官高敏, 親眼目擊大女兒被唐飛開鎗打死, 從此她的愛就只能寄放於小女兒丁玲身上。車禍後三個月, 昏迷的張日東終於醒來, 高敏第一時間要他踏入法庭受審。亡命之徒洪荊接其命令往活捉丁玲, 碰巧給唐飛撞上, 卻未能及時把丁玲救回。高敏收到恐嚇電話, 要保女兒的命就得撤銷對張日東控訴；一旦報警, 定必撕票。唐飛誓要救回丁玲, 以贖自己當日犯下的過失。唐飛在舊同僚新爺的協助下, 逐步逐步邁向洪荊的賊窩。然而, 最重要的線索卻在高敏的手機內, 高敏對他恨之入骨, 絕不肯向他透露半句, 唐飛在別無選擇之下, 唯有忍辱向昔日有爭執的舊下屬求助。高敏面對兩難局面, 不知如何是好, 但她仍堅決拒絕唐飛的協助。為救女兒的性命, 她決定不惜一切, 偷走案情的關鍵檔。唐飛與新爺終追尋到洪荊, 惜最後還是被洪荊逃去。唐飛把事情鬧大, 匪幫以為高敏報了警, 向高敏聲言要傷害丁玲以作警告。高敏得悉後, 死命阻止唐飛繼續調查, 但唐飛卻拿出有力證據, 指丁玲應該就在咫尺之間... 如現在放棄找尋, 丁玲可能不能活過當晚...就在此時, 洪荊察覺唐飛三人已找到來, 急忙之下, 洪荊即帶同丁玲匆忙離去, 留下躺在家中, 半身不遂的妻子阿麗。唐飛三人發現阿麗, 要求與洪荊交換人質!然而洪荊不肯妥協, 更施計從新爺手上搶回阿麗!唐飛憑著一點線索, 追蹤到洪荊, 終救回丁玲；高敏得知丁玲獲救, 及時把証物提交堂上, 張日東終被繩之於法。豈知洪荊死不放手, 一直追殺過來, 唐飛不敵, 丁玲獨自逃走之際, 竟遇上意外, 被活埋泥沙之下!唐飛追至, 丁玲已奄奄一息...

Who knows why they exist?” NARA, the successful careerwoman born with a side of crazy. Despite being brought together by a cinematic encounter that led to their storybook romance, the two have now grown sick of each other's nutty and loserish ways, finally deciding to become perfect strangers again. But......with D-30 until they stamp their papers, a fateful accident inflicts amnesia on the star-crossed couple.

programme.title: 30日求「分」大作戰

programme.title: The Rising Star -Kay Choi

As she approaches thirty and her career begins to take off, how will she face the society's definition toward women at her age, and what are her expectations for the future?

programme.title: CYBERHEIST
programme.desc: A menacing forest of fiber and data lies behind every digital screen. The Internet, while having given birth to many innovations, is also the nest of deadly computer viruses.Around the world, on a daily basis malicious hackers attack firewalls holding Governments, private companies and citizens hostage. In an attempt to bring him down, unfortunately Chun gets caught up in a money laundering operation where he discovers that his boss Chi is behind the attack. To fight Chi and regain his integrity and credibility, Chun has to venture into the dark web where he can deploy an all-powerful AI virus that he created; along the way taking down violent hit-men and hackers in order to uncover the evidence of Chi's crimes. programme.title: 斷網
programme.desc: 電子熒幕背後藏著一片詭秘的網絡森林, 滿佈光纖與數據, 是孕育技術與滋長病毒的奇幻空間。黑客們在網絡森林播毒, 發動了一次大規模的網絡襲擊, 幸得天才網絡保安主任卓家俊利用自身研發的防火牆, 化解危機。殊不知病毒攻擊原來是由其上司陳明志所操控, 家俊亦因此誤墮其洗黑錢圈套, 陷入險境。為證清白, 家俊與陳明志展開激烈鬥法。家俊暗中在網絡森林煉製具備人工智能 (AI) 的超級病毒, 更不惜游走危險領域 -潛伏並攻擊各路黑客, 誓要找出陳明志罪證!同時, 陳明志不擇手段, 命令黑客反奪家俊手上解密科技, 更綁架其女兒卓寶兒及恐嚇其妻子詠珊。家人生命受到威脅, 家俊受盡掣肘, 更禍不單行的是, 其研發的AI病毒失控, 迅速竄入各個電腦系統, 瞬間全城斷網, 引起莫大恐慌, 後果不堪設想...

A-cheng clumsily draws a “graffiti contract” to offset Hao-ting's debts with walks and dinners as dating, even tries his best to manage the funeral for her father. programme.title: 當男人戀愛時

programme.title: Movie Over Adversity: Golden Chicken
programme.desc: It is an exploration of one woman's wacky life of prostitution, spanning over 20 years in Hong Kong. Unattractive but happy-go-lucky and spunky, KUM is a true Hong Kong survivor.

programme.title: 逆境爭口「戲」！: 金雞
programme.desc: 一個風雨交加的晚上, 四十歲的阿金在銀行櫃員機中心被賊人阿邦持刀行劫, 但阿金戶口結餘只得$98.2, 無法提款；阿金一生色情事業, 更與香港廿年來的起落息息相關, 時至現今節衣縮食的關頭下, 阿金仍與香港共渡時艱, 投身「一樓一」自僱行列, 與香港市民同唱「獅子山下」﹗

programme.title: Baogu Select Music X Microfilm E267 -Through the Vast World
programme.desc: A twin-fish jade pendant binds two tragic escapes across a century. In the past, an opera fighter dies protecting a fleeing noblewoman. In present-day Hong Kong, enforcer Ah Shin is ordered to guard his boss's secluded mistress, Ah Ning. As haunting flashbacks intrude, hunters from both eras close in. Caught in a web of power and forbidden longing, they must confront their entwined fate: to repeat the past, or to rewrite it.

programme.title: 爆谷影之選 微電影「創+作」（音樂篇） 第267集 -雙魚
programme.desc: 一枚雙魚玉佩, 牽引兩段註定悲劇的逃亡。前世, 戲班武生為護格格殺出血路；百年後, 黑道手下阿信奉命看守被軟禁的情婦阿凝。當前世的記憶在夢境閃回, 今生的追兵已至門外。在權力羅網與曖昧情愫之間, 他們必須抉擇: 是重蹈覆轍, 還是扭轉命運的輪迴?

programme.title: Mrs. K
programme.desc: Mrs. K is a housewife who lives in a quiet suburban neighborhood with her husband Mr. K and their daughter Lil' K. One day, a Macau ex-cop shows up to blackmail Mrs. K. He knows about her unseemly past. She agrees to his term and they meet. The deal goes sour as she attempts to get rid of him. He escapes and is captured by a stranger. After finding out why Ex-cop is mixed up in this, the stranger kills him. They are after Mrs. K for different reasons. Ex-cop is someone who stumbles upon Mrs. K's identity and decides to try his luck. The stranger, however, bears a grudge against Mrs. K. Things would date back more than ten years ago when a Macau casino was robbed. The robbery was carried out by a band of professionals and was led by none other than Mrs. K...

programme.title: Mrs. K
programme.desc: K太太是一名家庭主婦, 與醫生丈夫K生以及十五歲的女兒細K一直過著恬靜的生活。有一天, 一名來自澳門的不速之客悄然駕到, 聲稱知曉K太不為人知的過去, 並以此為把柄勒索她, 這人叫馬騮, 是個曾當過警察的偵探, K太認定他沒來頭, 把他教訓了一頓, 令他知難而退。豈知, 馬騮卻被一名神秘人擄走, 經過一番拷問後慘遭殺害。馬騮只不過是個想碰運氣的潦倒偵探, 撞正神秘人, 反走了霉運。神秘人則不簡單, 他同K太有仇, 兩人的淵源還需回溯至多年前的一宗澳門賭場劫案, 而領導一群專業劫匪幹案的, 正是K太...

programme.title: Fly Me To Polaris
programme.desc: What if you are given a wish being the 60th billion person moving to 'Polaris' (or others call it 'Heaven'), will you do the same as Onion, who was blind and dumb when he's alive?

programme.title: 星願
programme.desc: 青年聰, 花名洋蔥頭是一個失明的啞巴, 父母雙亡的孤兒, 在醫院任職盲人凸字和錄音技師, 自給自足。性格樂觀的他, 不介意清苦的生活, 何況他還有唯一的朋友女護士秋男, 聰心儀對方但不敢表白。一天, 聰被車撞倒, 醒來時已進另一空間, 原來已死去並正等候往北極星開展另一新生...

programme.title: Zu: Warriors From The Magic Mountain
programme.desc: An army deserter Di Ming Qi, who was chased by vampires in the mountain of Zu. He was rescued by Master Ding Yin and became his pupil. When they were ambushed by the Blood Devil, devil chaser Xiao Ru and his pupil Yi Zhen came to their assistance. With the help of Master Chang Mei, they managed to hold off the Blood Devil but they need to find the Dual Swords to destroy it. Master Ding took the wounded Xiao Ru to Celestial Fort and sought help from the Mistress, but was in turned poisoned by the Blood Devil and he surrendered to the Dark Force. Will Di and Yi Chen find the Dual Swords and destroy the Blood Devil?

programme.title: 蜀山
programme.desc: 逃兵狄明奇於蜀山中險被屍妖所殺, 幸為大俠丁引所救。某天, 血魔在石林中伏擊丁, 降魔者曉如與徒弟一真助丁力戰之, 在危急之際, 幸得長眉真人趕至, 將血魔元嬰暫制於神鏡內；並道, 如需徹底殲滅血魔, 必須將天外天之紫青雙劍合壁。但曉如因中了血魔之毒, 被丁帶到瑤池堡主那裏療傷, 而丁亦因中了血魔之毒而投入了魔界, 最後只好由狄、一真與堡主的徒弟蘭去尋找紫青雙劍。究竟他們能否順利尋得紫青雙劍, 消滅血魔呢?

programme.title: The Intellectual Trio
programme.desc: Taiwanese detective Simon visits Hong Kong and is served by Wing, the young and witty cop. Their adventures begin when they encounter two pretty girls, Pretty eyes and Slant eyes. These two girls are pickpockets and have stolen a jade from the professional killer. The killer is desperate to get back his treasure, that even though the detectives try to protect the sisters, the four are in great danger...

programme.title: 龍鳳智多星
programme.desc: 臺灣刑警西門汀被派來港交流, 甫抵香港機場, 因方言不通, 險些兒破壞港警設置之緝毒工作, 可幸港方主管探長張榮機智奮勇, 終能拘捕毒梟歸案, 唯汀亦同時以毒販同謀身份被捕。在警署中汀被榮等加以拷問, 幸而榮之上級谷督察及時趕到將誤會澄清, 更派選榮負責招待汀以和解彼此間之誤會。在一次偶然場合, 汀與榮邂逅一雙扒手姊妹花, 家姐雙眼皮成熟艷麗, 細妹單眼皮清純可愛, 頓使榮與汀心儀不已。然而雙及單卻不假以顏色, 令榮與汀十分掃興!神秘鬍鬚男子乃海外職業殺手, 被聘來港執行神秘任務。當他依照指示在酒店取得目的物後, 竟被雙、單姐妹無意中取去。殺手心有不甘, 對雙、單姐妹窮追不捨...

programme.title: Farewell My Dearest
programme.desc: The film was set in the 1970s, Dai Cheng-wah was a top law student in the University of Hong Kong. He fell in love with an orphan Suk-fun. His father opposed this relationship. The lovers eventually got married and Suk-fun dropped out of school because of pregnancy. Cheng-wah continued his studies and graduated. Under his father's influence, he was only able to work in a shabby law firm. After Suk-fun gave birth to triplets, Cheng-wah had a heavy burden. Finally, Cheng-wah won lawsuit and gained fame. However, Suk-fun suddenly discovered she had terminal illness...

programme.title: 告別有情天
programme.desc: 七十年代的香港, 戴振華是法律世家的獨子, 也是港大法律系的高材生, 但卻偏偏愛上保良局孤兒淑芬。門當不戶對自然受到家長的阻撓, 振華父親多番反對亦不能令振華改變初衷。結果有情人終成眷屬, 淑芬因懷孕輟學, 振華繼續學業, 以優異成績畢業, 但在父親的影響下, 只能到一間破落的律師行任職。這時, 淑芬又誕下三胞胎, 落在振華身上的擔子相當沉重, 終於, 振華借著一場打勝了的官司而聲名大噪, 但好景不常, 淑芬突然發現自己身患絕症...

programme.title: BB30
programme.desc: Bau is a poor lawyer who has never won in litigation. He is a righteous guy but his unstable character brings him under disciplinary investigation, during which he meets a beautiful doctor, Cheng. However, since Cheng often deposes against Bau, misunderstanding and conflict grow between the two. On the other hand, Susan, an aerobic dancing instructor, has a deep passion for Bau for a long time and this makes Mo feel jealous and determine to go against him. As Bau and Mo go together, troubles and laughers are stirred up...

programme.title: BB30
programme.desc: 包有為是年青律師, 為人富正義感, 惟他一直未勝過一場官司, 反而因他的戇直而令他陷入律師公會的紀律調查之中。在調查中, 包遇上美麗的鄭可愛醫生, 但鄭的專業判斷, 對包作出不利的醫學供詞, 二人產生連串誤會。另一方面, 健康舞教師Susan一直痴戀包, 而她的裙下之臣沙展毛, 視包為眼中釘, 處處與包作對, 搞出笑話連篇...

programme.title: Dances With Dragon
programme.desc: Aaron, a young, successful Chinese businessman, drifts on to a rural island after a scuba accident. Mistaken for an illegal immigrant, he is forced to take refuge in a small, family-run grocery store. Enjoying the riches to rags transition, he tells nobody his true identity, and falls in love with the grocery store owner's daughter, Yvonne. But while Aaron enjoys his life of anonymity, Yvonne covets the chance to escape her poverty

programme.title: 與龍共舞
programme.desc: 十一家出術騙旅遊人士竟遇黑社會, 反被要脅, 月光唯有約眾當家講數 ; 家俊只有班兵去對付, 制服眾人後他們說是龍家俊主使, 家俊甚奇怪。母女決上龍門企業找龍家俊申冤, 後知悉全是鞏利之陰謀。家俊不辭而別返龍家別墅, 對母說要開盛大舞會, 舞會中用 '真心說話' 來騙鞏利自爆真相。月光趕到才知家俊真正身世, 俊要邀請一生最愛的人跳第一隻舞, 月光滿懷期待...

programme.title: The Lunatics
programme.desc: Social worker Fun specializes in counseling psychotics. Writer Yip is inspired by his mission and decides to work with him. One day, Fung is accidentally killed by a patient...

programme.title: 癲佬正傳
programme.desc: 馮為社工, 專門照顧精神病患者。葉在目睹馮一次行動後, 決定跟隨他工作。他倆見盡一切奇怪病人, 亦因救人而受傷。這次, 馮不幸在輔導時被斬身亡。葉雖悲痛, 仍承繼馮的使命。

programme.title: 1995 Collections: Romantic Dream
programme.desc: Dino Sau is a brilliant motor mechanic, able to supply a Mini Cooper with an engine powered by atomic energy. He falls in love with a beautiful, filthy-rich girl Vivian, but of course she already has a boyfriend. Years later, Dino is rich, and he meets his beloved again. She is now married to Gao Kun. Dino seeks the advice of an evil-minded guru, who implants him with dreams in which he can have his object of desire...

programme.title: 「戲」遊1995: 追女仔95之綺夢
programme.desc: 擁有機械裝嵌天份的孔志龍, 為人正直, 視汽車為他的最愛, 與友人合資開設一汽車修理工場。一天, 龍邂逅了阿敏, 被敏的天生麗質所吸引, 以為天賜良緣, 欲把握時機向敏示愛, 誰料敏卻突然消失, 像人間蒸發般遍尋不獲, 龍從此變得落落寡歡。轉眼九年, 龍因鑽研汽車零件成功, 事業獲得迅速發展, 商人高坤欲與之合作, 並介紹其妻與之認識, 龍發現坤之妻竟是敏, 頓感萬分失意。為補心靈上的創傷, 龍借助特異功能大師的法力讓其沉醉於夢境中, 他與愛侶重逢。但誰都曉得這只不過是一場夢...

programme.title: Moon Stars & Sun
programme.desc: May's from a broken family. Her step father abused her and her mother, and even made her to be a cabaret hostess. Then she fell in love with a bank manager however the love couldn't last; Gigi's husband was in jail. She became a hostess to raise money to get him out. Her husband was out but started to cheat on her; Porsche knew her best days were over as a hostess. She had been saving money for going to US to see her daughter. One day her ex-boyfriend came back from US and...

programme.title: 月亮星星太陽
programme.desc: May出身破碎家庭, 為了與弱母擺脫繼父虐待, 毅然下海伴舞, 認識了同樣坎坷的紅舞女Gigi與過氣小姐Porsche。一天, May 邂逅一位銀行經理, 但見Gigi, Porsche先後遭愛人拋棄, 心明歡場無真愛, 三人唯有認命, 但仍堅持面對命運...

programme.title: Twenty Your Life On 2 E7
programme.desc: 講述了大學畢業三年後，羅豔（李庚希飾）經媽媽介紹進入一家離家不遠的傳統型公司做閒差，別人羨慕她輕鬆悠閒，她卻厭倦了枯燥的生活；出入高檔寫字樓的姜小果（卜冠今飾）實際上每天加班沒有自己的生活；突如其來的家庭經濟危機讓段家寶（董思怡飾）從「富二代」變成了「負二代」；梁爽（關曉彤飾）成了全網頂尖的美妝護膚主播，但她的事業起起伏伏。儘管生活的路總是令人困惑而踟躕，但女孩們從不停止向前的腳步。這是充滿艱難，也充滿光明的25歲。

Making Pandas S1E1
programme.desc: The iconic Giant Panda is on the brink. With only 1600 left in the wild, pressures on their natural habitat and a notoriously small window for reproduction are edging them towards extinction - fast. Over 1 year, we go behind-the-scenes and follow the incredible work of a dedicated group of zookeepers and vets as they race to get Singapore’s famed couple… to fall in ‘love’. The team from the River Safari has a tough road ahead. This film follows the year that Kai Kai and Jia Jia become the focus of attention not just from the general public but from the scientists themselves in the greatest challenge Singapore Zoo has faced yet.

programme.desc: After being dropped off into the mountains where there were only whispers and tales of mountain monsters being seen. Mario is on the search of the outer limits of the mountains to find himself a monster red deer. His arrow successfully finds a big red and he showcases some recipes he learnt from the southern regions of Italy form leading celebrity chefs. But not before a mammoth carry out through the back country of the Deep South.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild S1E4 -Outback Odyssey / Arabian Camel
programme.desc: Mario teams up with good friend and precision rifle expert Bernard and heads into the high alpine mountains above New Zealnd’s rugged West Coast in search of tahr. Drawing on his Greek roots, Mario cooks a rustic “Kleftiko” dish in an earth oven.

programme.title: Brave Wilderness S2E15 -Giant Jungle Frog, Cheetah Encounter & Alligator Feeding Frenzy!
programme.desc: Coyote catches a giant frog, meets a cheetah, wrangles turtles, and feeds hungry alligators!

programme.title: Strangers in Danger S1E1 -Mexico
programme.desc: On a wild and dangerous adventure to Mexico, BMX bikers Rooftop and Catfish test how gutsy they really are. The pair go from racing bikes to racing donkeys, flame throwing and tricking in pointy shoes on the streets, to loosing their breakfast trying to eat eyeball tacos for lunch. But the duo’s bravery (or stupidity) doesn’t end there. They compete in a rodeo, milk a snake for its venom, spin upside down as Voladores in a traditional rain ceremony, and get tattoos right before diving into the city’s toxic sewage. With all of these dauntless activities the question becomes, can Rooftop and Catfish make it out of Mexico in one piece?

programme.title: Strangers in Danger S1E2 -Romania
programme.desc: Rooftop and Catfish’s travels take them to Romania, where the daredevil acts continue. After a chariot race in the countryside, the BMX bikers continue their attempt to become Romanian gladiators by flying through the air, jumping through flaming walls, and even lighting themselves on fire while riding their bikes. They get up close and personal with the sheep of the country, trying the Romanian delicacy of sheep’s head, but quickly move on to just milking the animal. Finally, the trip to this Eastern European country is not complete without trying to clean up the streets from Romania’s stray dog epidemic. Are Rooftop and Catfish able to save the strays or does the duo learn that they are all bark and no bite?

programme.title: Man Eats Wild S1E5 -Volcanic Kingfish / Kingfish
programme.desc: Mario hooks up with old friend and current world record holder for kingfish Rick Pollock . They fish the the coast of Newzealand just off a live Volcano, then tragedy strikes…… after the Volcano erupts mario returns to catch a whopping Bass Grouper and prepares an amazing ceviche dish.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild S1E6 -Mountain Monsters / Red Stag
programme.desc: Mario returns to his home land in Australia to help a friend with some wild boar pest control and catch some prehistoric fish out of a billabong…. But drama strikes and Mario finds him self in crocodile infested water plucking fish out with his bare hands…. All of these delicious bush treats are prepared of course in a termite oven which Mario makes.

programme.title: Brave Wilderness S2E15 -Giant Jungle Frog, Cheetah Encounter & Alligator Feeding Frenzy!
programme.desc: Coyote catches a giant frog, meets a cheetah, wrangles turtles, and feeds hungry alligators!

programme.title: Save this Rhino S1E1
programme.desc: Kevin Pietersen (KP) invites Matt Wright to South Africa, to visit the Kruger National Park area, and show him the state of play and understand the world of poaching. Aside from his success in cricket, KP has also been a fierce and passionate member of the global choir singing to save the rhino. It’s Matt’s first time in South Africa, but it’s not the first time he’s had to face the problem of endangered species. They will meet baby Arthur, who lost his mum to poaching alongside many other baby rhinos who suffered the same fate. Angered and emotional at this dire situation, KP and Matt seek answers to why people would do this. It’s an emotional experience, and it cements the need to find solutions fast, and there may be one already. What becomes blatantly obvious is that the problem is challenging and solutions convoluted.

programme.title: Save this Rhino S1E2
programme.desc: Although the situation is bleak, there is hope. Back at an undisclosed reserve, Matt, KP and Graeme Smith meet another kind of team saving rhinos. From perimeter and ground-based technologies to revolutionary communication and data analysing systems, they are diving into what could be the future of wildlife conservation. Technology seems an obvious solution, but it can’t be the sole strategy, so the team visit a local community who have started a wildlife tourism reserve, which blends employment with the survival of species. It really is a war that is intensifying, and the guys witness the high level of security to protect rhinos against impending incursions at a private game reserve where another baby rhino is roaming freely with his mum. Unfortunately, it’s the exception rather than the rule. Most rhinos struggle to survive. If they survive at all. The clock is ticking, and if these solutions don’t work, they might all be gone by 2025.

programme.title: Soda Master (Bilingual) E6
programme.desc: 三位51歲、對人生感到失意的中年大叔——吉井雄太、藤卷肇與菊原紀介，因故鄉傳來「工地挖出人骨」的新聞而重聚。他們原是少年時代的電影研究部夥伴，卻在回憶往昔時，驚覺他們的女顧問老師竟被標註為「行方不明」。這個發現，點燃了他們追查老師神祕失蹤真相的決心，也開啟了一段重新檢視自我與青春的救贖之旅。

programme.title: Where does the Sea Begin (Bilingual) E11
programme.desc: 大學時期的男主角月岡夏，與同學南雲水季交往起來，並過著幸福的日子。然而，正當他們都在忙著就業活動的時候，水季卻突然向他提出分手，從此兩人分道揚鑣。就這樣過了七年，已經開展新生活的夏，卻突然收到大學時代朋友的通知，原來水季已經離開了人世。從分手那天起就沒有再見過水季的夏，帶著難以置信的心情去參加了水季的葬禮。在葬禮上，夏見到了一個名叫海的小女孩，並得知她是水季和他的女兒，讓他感到十分震驚。原來當年水季竟瞞著他生下了他們的孩子，並且一直默默地撫養著這個孩子。知道這一切以後，夏開始思考水季和海在這七年間的生活。

programme.title: The Inner Eye (Bilingual) E17
programme.desc: 「常勝律師」唐盈盈（辛芷蕾飾）與頂頭上司康俊（林雨申飾）在一樁樁眾生百態的案件中過招，在碰撞中釐清中國式「人情與法理」難題，並最終收穫自身成長的動人故事。

programme.title: Our Golden Days (Bilingual) E69
programme.desc: 無論過去、現在、未來，每個別具意義的相遇都造就華麗的日子，且無論什麼人都曾經擁有過華麗的日子。事業、愛情兩得意的能力者李志赫遇上責任感強陽光開朗的咖啡廳經理兼室內設計師池恩悟。兩人儘管外表看似光鮮亮麗，但在經歷人生的低潮後仍守在對方身邊，克服各種試驗，找到人生的真諦。

programme.title: Phantom Lawyer (Bilingual) E2
programme.desc: 「申二朗」律師在舊巫堂開設法律事務所後，開始看得見鬼魂。雖然外表沉穩可靠，但實際上膽小又有些冒失；然而在面對帶著冤屈的鬼魂委託人時，卻展現出誰也無法動搖的堅定氣度。他與菁英律師「韓娜賢」以「法律」為武器替非常特別的委託人洗刷冤屈。
